description: Check a tool before your agent connects to it: how much money could the agent lose if it is wrong, hacked or prompt-injected? Returns the Agent Risk Score (custody, limits enforced outside the model, human approval, withdrawal scope, preview, open source, incident record), each input with its official source; missing inputs are listed, not guessed. Omit tool to rank every scored tool in a category (agent_wallet, agent_payments, ai_trading_agent, agent_token, bot_exchange, defi_agent).

category.description: Rank a category instead: agent_wallet, agent_payments, ai_trading_agent, agent_token, bot_exchange or defi_agent

name: get_risk
